verdict.rationale: DBOS supports scheduled (cron) workflows, background workflow starts via DBOS.start_workflow, queues for concurrent execution, and durable recovery from crashes, which together enable autonomous background automations. However, this is a developer library requiring code/annotations rather than a no-code 'set up automation' UX for AI-native/end users, and there's no evidence of a simple agent-facing interface for defining automations beyond writing Python/TS workflow code. Missing for 10: evidence of a no-code/low-code automation builder, natural-language or agent-driven automation setup, and independent hands-on confirmation that autonomous background runs work reliably outside vendor docs.
